summary: The Playwright test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly. The test preserves the testCaseId in the test title and has appropriate await usage for assertions. Selectors use data-test attributes, which are generally stable. Assertions are sufficiently strong to verify navigation, page title, and visibility of important product elements. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs are present. A minor deduction is for selector specificity, since relying on product-1, product-2, product-3 without further validation of product names or counts may be brittle in larger contexts.
recommendations: Consider adding assertions to verify the correctness of individual product details beyond visibility to increase robustness.
Verify that the selectors for product-1, product-2, and product-3 are stable and will not break if product ordering changes.
Consider abstracting selectors or using reusable functions if similar category page tests are added in the future.
